# Object types

Part of the [task classification](../task_classification.md) · **Object types** · [Roles](roles.md) · [Operations](operations.md) · [Categories](categories.md)

The types of objects an [operation](operations.md) reads and writes.

| Object | Content | Subtypes | nf-bioimage-spec aliases |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="image"></a>Image | Pixel intensities, one or more channels. | intensity, probability | `Image` |
| <a id="label"></a>Label | Integers on an image grid. | instance (one ID per object), class map (one value per class), skeleton | `LabelMask`, `ClassMask`, `SkeletonMask` |
| <a id="table"></a>Table | Rows of values under a header. | ROI, masking ROI, feature, condition, parameter | `Tabular`, `Scalar` |
| <a id="point-cloud"></a>Point cloud | Points with attributes. | | `Points` |
| <a id="vector"></a>Vector | 2D polygons and lines outlining objects. | | `Vector` |
| <a id="mesh"></a>Mesh | Vertices and faces of an object's surface. | | |
| <a id="graph"></a>Graph | Objects as nodes, links as edges. | tree, tracks, tracks with divisions | `SWC`, `Tracks`, `TracksWithDivision` |
| <a id="files"></a>Files | Anything outside OME-Zarr: raw acquisition files, collected metadata, exports. | | |

A subtype is named only where it changes what an operation accepts.

OME-Zarr has no adopted format for point clouds, vectors, meshes or graphs yet: one must be chosen before the first task that writes them.

## Mappings

No single ontology describes these types; only Image is well covered. Ontology terms are mapped with SKOS: *exact* (same concept), *close* (interchangeable in most uses), *narrow* (the external term is narrower, e.g. a binary mask is one kind of Label) and *related* (e.g. a point and a point cloud). Data models that are not ontologies, [SpatialData](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/stable/design_doc.html) and the BioImage Archive's [MIFA annotation types](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/), are linked by element name.

| Object | Ontology terms | Data models |
|---|---|---|
| Image | *exact*: [Image (EDAM)][data_Image]; *close*: [image (IAO)][IAO:0000101], [image (SIO)][SIO:000081] | SpatialData [images](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/stable/design_doc.html#images) |
| Label | *narrow*: [Binary Mask (NCIT)][NCIT:C201530] | SpatialData [labels](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/stable/design_doc.html#labels-pixel-mask), MIFA [segmentation_mask](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/) |
| Table | *close*: [table (IAO)][IAO:0000306], [table (SIO)][SIO:000419] | SpatialData [table](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/stable/design_doc.html#table-table-of-annotations-for-regions) |
| ROI Table | *related*: [Region of interest (EDAM)][data_Roi] | |
| feature Table | | MIFA [counts](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/), MIFA [derived_annotations](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/) |
| Point cloud | *related*: [point (SIO)][SIO:000507] | SpatialData [points](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/stable/design_doc.html#points), MIFA [point_annotations](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/) |
| Vector | *narrow*: [polygon (SIO)][SIO:000505], [polyline (SIO)][SIO:000545] | SpatialData [shapes](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/stable/design_doc.html#shapes), MIFA [geometrical_annotations](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/), MIFA [bounding_boxes](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/) |
| Mesh | | MIFA [geometrical_annotations](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/) |
| Graph | | MIFA [graphs](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/) |
| tracks Graph | *close*: [Object trajectory (EDAM)][data_Trajectory] | MIFA [tracks](https://bioimage-archive.github.io/bia-mifa-models/AnnotationType/) |
| Files | *close*: [file (SIO)][SIO:000396] | |

Label, Mesh, Point cloud and Graph (trees, skeletons) have no ontology term of their own. MIFA's annotation types are not mapped to an ontology either.
